subject.facility_name: CIVITA CARE CENTER AT SALMON BROOK

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $164.84 per resident day (41.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -1.5% (Connecticut median 2.5%).

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,054,302, $28.93 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $497,933 (47.2%), allocated fringe $151,889 (14.4%), non-wage costs $404,480 (38.4%). Raw food was $367,131 ($10.08 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $695,056, $19.08 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $510,280 (73.4%), allocated fringe $155,655 (22.4%), non-wage costs $29,121 (4.2%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $131,048, $3.6 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $87,452 (66.7%), allocated fringe $26,676 (20.4%), non-wage costs $16,920 (12.9%).
Cost year 2025: related party disclosed as "LTC Therapy Services" for Physical Therapy, cost reported $253,895 (Page 13/ Line 5a).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2023 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075060/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2023 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
